verdict.rationale: 2FAS is a 2FA authenticator and password manager, not an automation or workflow platform, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a category error for this product type. No evidence shows it ships any automation feature. Its backups, sync, and vault recovery cover token and vault data, not automations, and its llms.txt declares 'Public API: None'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
